name: Next.js Starter
description: Start a Next.js application from Vercel’s official starter.

deploymentRecipes.label: Vercel project
deploymentRecipes.notes: Creates a new Vercel project from a reviewed upstream Git revision. Requires Vercel access to the public Git repository. No database, storage integration or Git repository is created.

features.title: Native Vercel deployment
features.description: Select a saved account, review, and deploy from Workbox Cloud.

features.title: Pinned upstream source
features.description: Starts from a reviewed Git revision and preserves source attribution.

features.title: Managed lifecycle
features.description: View deployment status and build logs, or delete the created project.
